read_boundary_note: Read-phase boundaries differ: b00650d logs the phase before unmatched-read and input-stream destruction; v6 logs it after the input scope closes. These diagnostic elapsed times are not strictly equivalent intervals. Pending-mate cleanup may contribute to an observed difference; no entire delta is attributed to cleanup. End-to-end process wall time is the primary comparison.
selection_note: The original genotyped10k-fixed T8 configuration has an objective timing inconsistency in baseline formal round 2: process wall and application/UTC elapsed times disagree. Its entire original result file and all runs remain in evidence. Main tables use the original T1/T4 configurations and the complete independent T8 recheck (three formal pairs plus one warmup), rather than selecting individual favorable repetitions. No measurements are changed. Original T8 is excluded only from selected main statistics.
